name: Ink Sweep
summary: A website menu where a calligraphy brush flies to the link you pick and paints it with a swash of ink
about: A top navigation bar for a calligraphy studio site. When you pick a link, the old ink stroke dries and lifts away, a small bamboo brush flies over on an arc, presses down with a flick of ink drops and paints a fresh swash, and the label turns paper-coloured exactly where the ink passes. The page below changes with it: the words rise in, the ink circle is drawn again from a new angle and a red seal is stamped.
how: Click a menu link, or Tab to it and press Enter; the left and right arrow keys move along the menu.
Point at a link to see a faint dry-brush preview under it.
Use Book a class or the button under the heading to jump to another section.
The menu plays a short tour by itself until you click or press a key.
